scripts.check:clean: test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo 'Commit or remove every change first, so that what is built and published is a commit.' >&2; exit 1; }
scripts.package: pnpm check:clean && pnpm build:production && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir dist/packages --filename haystack-chrome-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/packages --filename haystack-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.run:firefox: pnpm build:local && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox --no-reload --no-input --start-url http://localhost:5173
scripts.package:source: pnpm check:clean && mkdir -p dist/packages && git -C ../.. archive --format=zip --add-file=apps/extension/README.md --output=apps/extension/dist/packages/haystack-source.zip HEAD
scripts.sign:firefox: pnpm package:source && pnpm build:production && web-ext sign --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/packages --channel unlisted --upload-source-code dist/packages/haystack-source.zip
